messages:
alex_infra: Heads-up: rolling a small IPMI/BMC hotpatch to eu-central racks at 02:00 UTC. Patch includes watchdog backoff adjustments + one secure-boot toggle fix that should stop intermittent PXE failures. Canaries first (rack-euc-03: node[01-03]), ~15m per node expected. opsbot posted schedule below :calendar:

opsbot: Deploy scheduled by alex_infra: 2025-04-09T02:00Z -> patch v2.44a to eu-central canary then parallel. Canary nodes: rack-euc-03-node01, node02, node03. Auto-rollback on non-responsive console > 10m.

sophia_oncall: Thanks — I'll be on call. Can we cordon GPU nodes before the reboot? I don't want active pods getting mid-update evictions.

alex_infra: Yes — canary we won't drain to speed validation, but for broader rollout we'll cordon+drain. Command we'll run for scaling: 
```
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```

jen_prodeng: Request: mark dedicated customer fleets (cust-tilt-reserved) to avoid draining those nodes; point them to fallback pool if needed. Also add a health-check probe for BMC responsiveness in the rollout job.

liam_hw: FYI one of the canary hosts had a PSU hiccup last month. If BMC resets repeatedly we may hit NVMe controller recovery which delays node join by ~7-10m. Keep an eye on nvme log.

ev an_sre: (joining) I'm watching logs. After node01 got the patch in canary, it rebooted fine but console hung on boot output at "usb 1-1: reset port" for ~6m then continued. Node02 failed to report to k8s after 12m. Serial shows: 
```
BMC> ipmi: session closed by user
console: uefi: error: secure boot policy mismatch, refusing PXE chain
kernel: nvme0: controller reset required
```

sophia_oncall: Node02 still out? Any workaround to get it back quickly?

evan_sre: Attempted soft mc reset via IPMI, didn't help. Next step was ipmitool BMC reflashing with staging image (same build but without the secure-boot toggle change). Reflashed node02 BMC and did mc reset cold -> console came back and PXE proceeded. Steps used: 
```
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P $PASS mc reset cold
fwupdate -b staging-bmc-2.44a-no-sb-toggle.bin --force
```

jen_prodeng: Good catch. Can we update the runbook to prefer staging-image revert if node fails to rejoin >10m? Also capture exit codes of fwupdate.

alex_infra: Agreed. For rollout: expanding to rest of eu-central paused. We're reverting the secure-boot toggle in the main image and will re-run canary with the revised build in ~30m. Avoids rolling back full firmware fleet.

liam_hw: Noted: hardware team will tag any node that needed BMC reflashes so we can audit warranty/flash counts — keep list in the ticket.

opsbot: Rollout paused by alex_infra at 02:18Z due to two canary rejoin failures. Auto-rollback disabled by user.

evan_sre: Quick perf/cost note — because we cordoned/drained a handful of nodes some scheduled GPU jobs moved to burst capacity in us-west. Additional cloud egress/networking for data-shuffle ~+$180 for the hour. Not a blocker but flagging for finance.

sophia_oncall: I'll file a short post-incident with timeline and the affected nodes (rack-euc-03-node02). We'll also add a monitoring alert for "BMC console silence >5m post-reset" to catch this sooner.

alex_infra: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) revert secure-boot toggle in image and run canary again (me/jen), (2) add staging-image revert to runbook (jen/evan), (3) tag hardware-flashed nodes and note warranty (liam), (4) postmortem + cost note (sophia). Will follow up in #postmortems in ~2h. :thumbsup:
